tasks.objective: SARIF, GitHub annotations, CodeClimate and JUnit paths are relative to the git repository root (or carry the subfolder prefix) when the MapX workspace is below it, so GitHub code scanning and PR annotations point at the right files.
tasks.description: Limitation of M5-07 (2026-11-03): reporters write workspace-relative paths; in a repository whose MapX workspace is a subfolder (monorepo), code scanning and annotations miss the files.
acceptanceCriteria: A workspace at repo/sub: SARIF uri, ::error file= and CodeClimate path are sub/…, JUnit file attributes too (test, all four formats).
A workspace at the repo root or outside git is unchanged (goldens hold).

tasks.title: CI reporters: baselines outside the repository and submodule workspaces
tasks.objective: A baseline outside the git repository is reported with a path SARIF consumers accept (absolute file URI or omitted location with a message), and a workspace inside a submodule can be prefixed relative to the superproject when asked.
tasks.description: M5-07-R1 limitations: a baseline outside the repo gives `../../outside/bl.json` outside %SRCROOT%; a submodule workspace is prefixed relative to the submodule.
acceptanceCriteria: A baseline outside the repo produces SARIF that validates against the schema with no `..` uri (test).

tasks.title: Git refs and paths never reach a shell
tasks.objective: A `--since` ref from `mapx arch changed`, `mapx check` or an MCP tool runs no shell syntax and cannot become a git option; every git call passes an argument array.
tasks.description: Found by the review of M5-14 (2026-11-03, P0, reproduced): `since: "HEAD^{/.|$(touch PWNED)}"` is a valid git ref (commit-message regex), passes rev-parse, and getChangedFiles put it into an execSync shell string, so the command ran. M5-08 (`mapx arch changed --since`) already exposed it on the CLI; M5-14 would expose it to MCP agents. Also: `mapx ui --open` built a shell string with the user's --host.
acceptanceCriteria: getChangedFiles with `HEAD^{/.|$(touch PWNED)}`, `HEAD;touch X` or a backquoted ref creates no file (tests/git-injection.test.ts, real git).
A ref starting with `-` (`--output=X`) is refused and writes no file (test); a real ref still diffs (test).
No git call in src/ uses a shell string (grep in the report).
